latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Movie Maker Free Download — fast, cloud-based video editing with no install required.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files (up to 500MB) for quick video editing and export.
- Automatic setup with free anonymous token (100 credits, 7-day expiry); seamless cloud connection.
- Simple user prompts control smart trimming, transitions, BGM, text overlays, and export.
- Session-based workflow: keep editing and refining before export; progress updates during long jobs.
- Automatic handling of common errors: invalid tokens, file limits, credit issues, and export restrictions.
- Render jobs processed in the cloud (1–2 minutes for short clips); export as polished MP4 video.
